name: Read DLFS File
description: Read a file from a DLFS drive. The 'mode' parameter controls how the file is returned: 'auto' (default) returns UTF-8 text for text files, or a reference with a WebDAV URL for binaries; 'text' forces UTF-8 decoding; 'bytes' returns base64-encoded bytes; 'json' parses the file as JSON and returns the value. For binary files, prefer fetching via the WebDAV GET transport at /dlfs/{drive}/{path} rather than using 'bytes' mode.
creator: Covia

mode.description: Decoding mode (default 'auto'). 'extract' returns the readable text of a PDF or Office document with pages marked — needs the documents module (v/info/adapters/documents lists the supported types).

pages.description: With mode 'extract': a page (or slide) number, a range like "3-5", or {first, last} — 1-based, inclusive

maxChars.description: With mode 'extract': cap the returned text (the module's default applies when omitted); 'truncated' reports when it cut and 'lastPage' how far it got

content.description: File content (present for modes auto/text/bytes). Text for utf-8 encoding, base64 for bytes.

value.description: Parsed JSON value (present for mode=json only).

encoding.description: 'utf-8', 'base64', or 'binary'. 'binary' means bytes were not inlined — fetch via the 'url' field.

url.description: WebDAV URL to fetch raw bytes (present when encoding=binary)
